mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, provider_type, provider_name, config_value, secret_ref, enabled, version, updated_by, updated_at
mapper.select:
select
from provider_setting where workspace_id = #{workspaceId} order by provider_type asc, provider_name asc
mapper.insert: insert into provider_setting ( id, workspace_id, provider_type, provider_name, config_value, secret_ref, enabled, version, updated_by, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{providerType}, #{providerName}, #{configValue}, #{secretRef}, #{enabled}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} ) on duplicate key update config_value = #{configValue}, secret_ref = #{secretRef}, enabled = #{enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
